![Features](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/676447/description_241dfa18-3e41-4400-99a9-cc1eedeb24d9.png)

- Three themes to choose from: Gradient Mode, Dark Mode and Standard
- Beautiful Armory packed with information
- Custom-built Profile Updater to keep up with the changes
- Install & update landing pages for information and ease-of-access
- Elegant WunderBar to have all the important information at your fingertips
- Unique hand-made specialization icons
- Game Menu Skin to personalize your gameplay and provide useful information
- Enhanced custom installer
- Active Discord community
- …and more!

![Requirements](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/676447/description_63516ad4-2c2e-4383-b5c8-29f43db86c80.png)

## Required AddOns:

- [ElvUI](https://www.tukui.org/download.php?ui=elvui)

## Recommended AddOns:

- [ElvUI WindTools](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/elvui-windtools) _(Retail only)_

## Additional supported AddOns:

- [WarpDeplete](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/warpdeplete) _(Retail only)_

![Installation](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/676447/description_eef9d427-56cd-4167-a38e-59f260b92ac1.png)

For detailed instructions, check out our installation guide on the [ToxiUI website](https://toxiui.com/)!

- Make a backup of your WTF folder _(it is recommended to install ToxiUI on a clean profile)_
- Install the required addons
- Enter game & make sure that all of the AddOns are loaded correctly
- Once you load up your character, the ToxiUI installer will pop-up
  - If ElvUI installer pops up first, simply `/reload`, you don't need to go through its installation process!
- Simply **follow** the installers **instructions very closely**
- If you have any problems or issues at any step, please visit our discord server for support!

## How to keep up to date with repo

### Windows OS

1. Clone the repository
2. `git checkout development`
3. Create a [symlink directory junction](https://www.howtogeek.com/howto/16226/complete-guide-to-symbolic-links-symlinks-on-windows-or-linux/)
   1. Open up Command Prompt **as administator**
   2. `mklink /J <new path> <old path>`

#### Example:

```sh
mklink /J "D:\Games\World of Warcraft\_retail_\Interface\AddOns\ElvUI_ToxiUI\" C:\Users\Toxi\Documents\GitHub\toxiui
```

## Development workflow

### Use the `development` branch

The `stable` branch should be updated only every big (non-beta) release, so that we have a reference.

⚠️ **2023-07-15:** Moving the release CI to `development` branch. `stable` will only be used as a reference point, but even then not sure if needed with the amount of commits we have nowadays.

### Pull requests only

⛔️ Please do not push code to the `stable` or `development` branches and only use Pull Requests.

### Code formatting

Please install the stylua extension and setup to format on save

```json
// settings.json
{
  "editor.formatOnSave": true,
  "[lua]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "JohnnyMorganz.stylua"
  }
}
```

🔗 https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=JohnnyMorganz.stylua

## Chat Commands:

### General (user facing)

_Prefix: `/tx` `/txui` `/toxi` `/toxiui`_

`/tx` - ElvUI TXUI Options Dialog _(alias of /tx settings)_

`/tx changelog` - ElvUI TXUI Options showing ONLY the changelog _(alias of /tx cl)_

`/tx wb` - ElvUI TXUI Options showing ONLY WunderBar _(alias of /tx wunderbar)_

`/tx badge` - Disable chat badges _(only possible if you actually have a chat badge)_

`/tx export names` - Export a list of all character names where ElvUI was active

`/tx reset` - Resets all TXUI Settings _(not the ElvUI profile itself, tho a re-install is needed to gain access to TXUI features back)_

`/tx status` - Shows the Diagnostic Popup _(alias of /tx info)_

`/tx install` - Shows the Installer Dialog for TXUI _(alias of /tx i)_

`/tx update` - Opens the Profile Updater _(alias of /tx u)_

`/tx landing [update]` - Shows the fresh install landing page, or the update one with `update` _(alias of /tx lp [u])_

`/tx debug on|off` - Disables all non-essential AddOns & enables Lua errors for troubleshooting, `off` restores them

### Retail & Forever Only

`/cd` - Toggle Cooldown Manager settings window _(aliases: `/cdm`, `/wa`)_

`/em` - Open Edit Mode

### Dev Section (or beta builds)

`/tx dev profile [dps|healer|private|details|font]` - Install the ElvUI Profile, Privates, Details or Fonts without confirmation

`/tx dev cvar` - Sets the default ElvUI Cvars _(+ personal change)_

`/tx dev chat` - Install a custom chat config

`/tx dev wb` - Enables the wunderbar debug mode

`/tx dev dpi <number>` - Gives you a scaled pixel perfect number (Magic Config Number -> Actual Number)

### Devs Only

`/tx dev toggle` - Toggles Developer mode, which activates overrides

`/tx dev splash` - Shows the Splashscreen for 15 Seconds

`/tx dev export names` - Triggers the import of badge names (decode)

releases.notes:
# ToxiUI v7.6.4 - 2026-11-23

**Full Changelog**: [https://github.com/Toxicom/toxiui/compare/v7.6.3...v7.6.4](https://github.com/Toxicom/toxiui/compare/v7.6.3...v7.6.4)

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Friendly Nameplates no longer have a max width as their names aren't secret
- [Forever] SpecSwitch & **Armory** now show your class icon instead of the default icon
- Fix Status Report, Profile Updater and Landing Page buttons using the default WoW font

# ToxiUI v7.6.3 - 2026-11-23

**Full Changelog**: [https://github.com/Toxicom/toxiui/compare/v7.6.2...v7.6.3](https://github.com/Toxicom/toxiui/compare/v7.6.2...v7.6.3)

## 🚀 New Features

- [Forever] **WunderBar**: Achievements button in the MicroMenu now opens the Legacy system
  - Credits to bifferz for initial PR
- ElvUI: New `Max Width` option for Unit Frame Custom Texts and Nameplate names, long text gets cut off with '...'
  - Works on secret names in instances, which can't be shortened by tags
  - Found next to the other text settings in ElvUI options

## 📘 Documentation

- Increase minimum required **ElvUI** version to `16.02`

## ♻️ Settings Refactoring

- ElvUI settings that ToxiUI overrides are now greyed out with a note saying which feature controls them and where to change it
  - Covers Gradient Mode colors, Dark Mode transparency, AFK Mode, Armory, Action Bar visibility and the Cooldown Manager Class/Power Bar overrides
- ElvUI unit frame Text Format boxes now explain that ToxiUI uses Custom Texts instead, with a button to open them

## 🔧 Development Improvements

- Supporter badges are now self-service: Patreon supporters register their characters with `/supporter register` in Discord
  - Use `/tx export names` in game to get your registration code
  - The old hand-maintained supporter list has been retired, please register to keep your badge

# ToxiUI v7.6.2 - 2026-11-09

**Full Changelog**: [https://github.com/Toxicom/toxiui/compare/v7.6.1...v7.6.2](https://github.com/Toxicom/toxiui/compare/v7.6.1...v7.6.2)

## 🚀 New Features

- Gradient Mode: Nameplates
  - ElvUI nameplate health now uses gradients, sharing the class, NPC and state colors with your UnitFrames
  - New editable threat and classification gradient colors

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Gradient Mode: Follower dungeon NPCs now get their class colors right away instead of after a `/reload`

## 📘 Documentation

- Random tips: Added a lot of new tips and refreshed outdated ones
  - Some tips are only shown on clients where the feature exists
- Increase minimum required **ElvUI** version to `16.01`

# ToxiUI v7.6.1 - 2026-11-06

**Full Changelog**: [https://github.com/Toxicom/toxiui/compare/v7.6.0...v7.6.1](https://github.com/Toxicom/toxiui/compare/v7.6.0...v7.6.1)

## 🚀 New Features

- [Forever] **Armory** support
  - Styles the Forever character sheet, its stats list and the ranged slot

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Additional Scaling: Fixed an error when opening the Collections window in combat
- [Classic] [TBC] [Forever] Gradient Mode: Power colors were missing from the settings
- [Forever] Support for first & last character names
  - Gold, played time, the `AFK` screen & `Game Menu` now use your full name and no longer show internal realm names

# ToxiUI v7.6.0 - 2026-11-05

**Full Changelog**: [https://github.com/Toxicom/toxiui/compare/v7.5.6...v7.6.0](https://github.com/Toxicom/toxiui/compare/v7.5.6...v7.6.0)

## ‼️ Breaking Changes

- Removed BigWigs support
  - The BigWigs profile, `/tx profile bw` command and the BigWigs pull timer skin are gone

## 🚀 New Features

- [Forever] Support for World of Warcraft: Forever
  - Includes the Cooldown Manager and Blizzard Damage Meter skins, **WunderBar** and the ToxiUI profile
- [Retail] **WunderBar** MicroMenu: Show your character stats in the Character button tooltip
  - Item level, primary stat, secondary stats and tertiary stats you have
  - Can be toggled in MicroMenu settings
- [Retail] New **WunderBar** module: Weekly
  - Shows your keystone, Mythic+ rating or Great Vault progress
  - Shows Vault Ready while last week's Great Vault rewards are waiting to be claimed
  - Tooltip with Great Vault rewards, this week's runs, coffer keys and dungeon scores
  - Left click toggles the Great Vault, Shift-Left links your keystone
  - Right click teleports to your keystone's dungeon, Shift-Right opens the season teleports
- [Retail] **WunderBar** DataBar: New House Favor mode
  - Tooltip with house level, favor, next level unlocks, neighborhood endeavor, decor storage and teleport cooldown
  - Left click toggles the Housing Dashboard, Right click teleports home, Shift-Left toggles the House Editor at home
  - Auto mode now shows house favor while you're at your house or plot
- [Retail] **WunderBar** MicroMenu: Right click the Housing button to teleport home, or return from a visit
- [Retail] Cooldown Manager: Color Buff Bar viewer bars with your Gradient Mode class colors
  - Can be toggled in the Cooldown Manager settings, requires Gradient Mode
- Gradient Mode: Gradients for your class bar (combo points, holy power, chi, runes, essence and more)
  - Every resource has its own customizable colors in the Bars tab, combo points default to ElvUI's colors

## ✨ Enhancements

- Gradient Mode: Fewer unit API calls per health update
- Reduced memory churn of the internal event system by reusing callback lists between events
- Options pages & changelogs are now built when the ElvUI config is first opened instead of on every login
- ElvUI Theme: Shadows now follow their frame's level & strata through per-frame hooks
  - Previously every frame level/strata change of every frame in the game went through ToxiUI
- `[tx:name]` & `[tx:health:percent:nosign]` tags no longer update on every frame when you change targets
- [Retail] VehicleBar: Vigor bar timers now only run while the bar is visible
- [Retail] Cooldown Manager: Keybinds no longer rescan all action bars & restyle their text on every cooldown update
- **WunderBar**: ElvUI stat datatexts (Haste, Crit, Speed, etc.) now only update on your own aura & stat changes
  - Previously they updated on aura changes of every raid member and nameplate
- **WunderBar**: ElvUI datatexts skip text processing when their text hasn't changed
- **WunderBar** DataBar: Coalesce quest log updates and ignore non-reputation combat text
- **WunderBar** Flyouts: Stop cooldown timers when the flyout closes
- Animations: Reuse colors for the RGB animation instead of creating new ones every frame

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Installer: Fixed the UI reload at the end of the installation being blocked by the game
  - You now get a popup with a Reload UI button instead
- Additional Scaling: Fixed load-on-demand frames (Collections, Auction House, Inspect, Professions, etc.) not being scaled until the slider was changed
- [Mists] Fixed Objective Frame position not being applied by the profile
- Armory: Fixed conflict detection with Shadow & Light Inspect/Stats and Eltruism Classic Armory
- Minimap Coordinates: Fixed coordinates not updating when moving along only one axis
- Fixed Dead & Offline Icons still reacting to setting changes after being disabled
- **WunderBar** Hearthstone: Fixed a potential error when a teleport spell has no cooldown info
- [Retail] Fixed potential secret value errors in name tags, Vehicle Bar vigor segments, Role Icons, Raid Info Frame and Armory stats
- [Retail] Cooldown Manager: Fixed icon centering no longer following buffs appearing mid-combat after changing any Cooldown Manager setting until a reload
- Gradient Mode & Dark Mode: Fixed color setting changes refreshing group frames with a stale unit
- Fixed old profile conversions modifying the default Saturation Boost settings and possibly skipping custom text renames

## 🧩 Profile Updates

- [Retail] ElvUI Unitframes: Use ElvUI's default aura filters
  - Removed aura filter settings that ElvUI no longer uses since its Midnight aura rework
- ElvUI Unitframes: Keep Player & Pet frames visible in Mythic+ like every other instance difficulty

## 📘 Documentation

- [Retail] Update currencies for Midnight Season 2

## ♻️ Settings Refactoring

- Gradient Mode: More compact color settings, two columns and fewer tabs
  - The preview bar now shows the colors with Saturation Boost applied
- The ToxiUI logo in the options is now only shown on the General page
